sloka: रावणं निहतं श्रुत्वा राघवेण महात्मना ।अन्तःपुराद्विनिष्पेतू राक्षस्यः शोककर्शिताः ।। ६.११३.१ ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇaṁ nihataṁ śrutvā rāghaveṇa mahātmanā ।antaḥpurādviniṣpetū rākṣasyaḥ śokakarśitāḥ ।। 6.113.1 ।।

translations.english: On seeing Ravana killed by the great soul Raghava, the Rakshasas from the gynaeceum stricken with grief rushed out.
